authority.name: Global Biodiversity Information Facility
authority.publisher: GBIF Secretariat as API aggregator; 13 underlying occurrence publishing organizations are represented in the retained statewide response.

terms.license: Per-record Creative Commons licenses retained from GBIF: CC BY 4.0, CC BY-NC 4.0, and CC0 1.0.

geography.method: Require explicit GBIF stateProvince text matching Arkansas and explicit GBIF county-equivalent text that resolves uniquely through the registered active county-equivalent registry to FIPS 05119.
geography.coordinatePolicy: Coordinates are not used for county assignment; missing, ambiguous, retired, conflicting, or coordinate-only county-equivalent geography is rejected.

taxonomy.method: Use the strict GBIF species match endpoint and require EXACT match type, confidence at least 95, SPECIES rank, a numeric species key, and exact canonical binomial agreement; revalidate each occurrence taxon key and binomial.

requests.purpose: Resolve the target to a strict exact GBIF species identity before occurrence acquisition.
Acquire the complete statewide Arkansas preserved-specimen occurrence response for the exact matched taxon and screen the leased Pulaski County pair by explicit provider county-equivalent text.

limitations: The registered source has no negative semantics; an empty query, source silence, or a rejected occurrence cannot support verified absence.
GBIF occurrence search does not provide target-specific survey method, effort, or an explicit negative result and therefore cannot support not-detected.
Only qualifying positive preserved-specimen occurrences can become determination evidence.

caveats: GBIF is an aggregator and publisher record quality can vary.
The retained statewide response contains 43 records across 14 datasets and 13 publishing organizations with mixed per-record licenses.
The latest lastInterpreted value in the retained occurrence response is 2026-07-27T22:31:33.907+00:00; freshness does not make the source an exhaustive inventory.

No retained occurrence explicitly identifies Pulaski County, Arkansas. Six records with ambiguous provider county text were preserved as explicit rejections; exact resolvable provider counties represented other Arkansas counties.
The completed Pulaski County screen produced no qualifying positive assertion and remains researched unresolved only. It does not support verified absence or non-detection.
